report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94ms durations; logs show ok results and metrics show zero 502s on /v1/checkout. The alert describes healthy behavior, not a fault. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause (no 500s, no pool/redis/downstream latency signals, no memory-retention data, no config errors). Deployment record only proves gateway v1.0.0 baseline. Insufficient evidence to establish a bounded root cause; handing off.
missing_evidence: Evidence of actual failure or latency degradation on /v1/checkout (e.g., non-2xx responses or elevated p95 beyond baseline)
Downstream dependency latency/error metrics for order, inventory, payment, postgresql, redis
Resource metrics (memory, connection pool) for gateway and downstream services
Configuration change records or error logs indicating bad configuration
